{黄色|きいろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{黄色|きいろ}い⟦バナナ→バナナ：01013_banana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: When autumn comes, the leaves turn yellow.

notes:
USAGE:
{黄色|きいろ} is one of the basic Japanese color words.

MULTIPLE FORMS:
- As noun: {黄色|きいろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (I like yellow)
- As no-adjective: {黄色|きいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ (yellow clothes)
- As i-adjective: {黄色|きいろ}い⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (yellow flowers)

NOTE: Unlike most colors, {黄色|きいろ} can become an i-adjective ({黄色|きいろ}い).

COLLOCATIONS:
- {黄色|きいろ}い⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: shrill voice (of excited women/children)

BASIC COLORS: ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧, ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧, {黄色|きいろ}, ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧, ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧, ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧.
